newsitem.title: GERMANY: Police say bomb scare at Leipzig station over.
newsitem.headline: Police say bomb scare at Leipzig station over.

text.p: German police said on Wednesday they had lifted emergency measures at Leipzig main train station following a bomb scare.
Police said they had cordoned off areas of the station and started looking for a bomb after five television stations received telephone warnings that a bomb had been planted there.

Police said the television stations had first been told a bomb was due to explode at 4.30 p.m. (1430 GMT) and then at 5.30 p.m. (1530 GMT), but after that time had passed without incident police called off their emergency measures.
A Reuter correspondent at the station said business was normal.
